messages:
Jordan: FYI — Acme Health wants a 2-week POC for clinical note summarization + downstream QA. They expect low latency and strict data controls. Can we align on acceptance criteria, cost guardrails, and the security asks?
Evelyn: quick context — POC scope: ingest ~50k notes, interactive querying via LLM (chat), and batch nightly summarization. Concurrency: peak ~40 rps. Avg tokens per request ~800.
Anita: security checklist: customer requires VPC peering (no public egress), customer-managed KMS for data at rest, and audit logs to a syslog endpoint. Also need SOC2 + pen test summary.
Mike: pricing note — rough hosted estimate for 2 weeks: assuming 50k notes x avg 800 tokens ~ 40M tokens + chat usage -> ballpark 45M tokens. At our list pre-sale rate that maps to ~ $1,350 (hosted). Dedicated quote will be different. Will surface committed burn options if they want reserved capacity.
Sam: on acceptance criteria, propose short list:
- Quality: QA accuracy >= 90% on a curated set of 200 golden prompts (binary QA / extraction correctness).
- Latency: median latency <= 120ms, p95 <= 300ms for chat flows under 40 rps.
- Cost: 2-week POC budget cap of $1,800 (hosted) or equivalent committed credits.
- Security: VPC peering + KMS + audit logs in place before any PHI is ingested.
Luis: a couple of asks from infra: how big are the artifacts (KV cache growth)? if we see long contexts we should pre-quantize the model. Also need to know allowed fallback policy if capacity hits dedicated limits.
Evelyn: for evals we should run a 200-prompt holdout (golden) and compute exact-match + F1 where applicable. Suggest pass if EM >= 90% OR F1 >= 0.88 for NER-ish extractions.
Anita: compliance gating: they flagged one question — do we support bringing your own HSM for key wrapping? Answer: we support KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK); BYOHSM would need enterprise plan + engineering handshake. I'll flag with them.
Mike: pricing follow-up: if they want VPC/private we can do a short-term dedicated pricing: 2-week reserved mini-pool estimate $2,800 (including transient infra). That's a separate line item.
Jordan: timeline: start Mon next week, week 1: ingest + baseline evals, week 2: tuning + acceptance runs. Final acceptance demo end of week 2.
Sam: test plan snippet to run during week1:
```
# eval harness pseudo
PROMPTS = load_csv('golden_200.csv')
results = []
for p in PROMPTS:
  out = call_endpoint(p)
  results.append(score(out, p.expected))
report = summarize(results)
# metrics: exact_match, f1, mean_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms
```
Sam: pass criteria check: exact_match >= 0.90 AND p95_latency_ms <= 300 AND total_cost <= budget_cap
Evelyn: ops note — we should enable prefix KV caching for summarization to save tokens; recommend model quantization setting q4_0 for batch runs. That will reduce cost ~25%.
Anita: security ops — before ingest: we need signed SLA + data processing addendum. No real data in shared dev environment until VPC is validated.
Jordan: blockers: customer legal wants KMS BYO answer; if they insist BYOHSM it's a deal-breaker for quick POC. Need decision from legal/partnerships this week.
Mike: next steps for pricing: I'll send two line items (hosted POC, short dedicated). Expect to share by EOD.
Luis: engineering action: we'll provision a test pool and a network diagram for VPC peering. ETA 48h after PO sign.
Evelyn: I'll assemble the golden prompts and the initial eval harness and drop into the shared drive.
deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/poc-test-pool -> requested, status: provisioning (no downtime expected). :rocket:
Jordan: agreed owners: Evelyn (evals), Mike (pricing/contract), Anita (security/compliance), Luis (infra), Sam (SLOs/metrics). We'll reconvene Thursday 10am PT to confirm gating items.
Mike: sending the hosted vs dedicated POC quote now.
Evelyn: thanks — I'll prep acceptance checklist and share the exact prompt set before EOD. :thumbsup:
